reduction_audit.element: Multiple stacked weather metrics (UV index, wind speed, pressure) on place cards
reduction_audit.rationale: Overloads the card. A traveler visiting a temple only needs temperature and general sky condition (e.g. '31°C · Sunny'). Detailed meteorology belongs in a secondary detail tap.

reduction_audit.element: Floating decorative compass rose and ornamental scale bar on Map canvas
reduction_audit.rationale: Purely decorative fluff. Native Google Maps and Apple MapKit have built-in legal scale and compass indicators.

reduction_audit.element: Persistent full-page conversational AI chat screen in Plan tab
reduction_audit.rationale: Simplified from a full conversational UI into a structured constraint form (Days, Pace, Corridor) with a concise, optional natural language prompt bar. Faster, cheaper, and more reliable.

reduction_audit.element: Number of badges per card header
reduction_audit.rationale: Capped at a maximum of 2 badges simultaneously (e.g. [Verified Official] + [Live 31°C]). If more exist, collapse into a single '+2 details' chip to prevent badge pollution.

reduction_audit.element: Multi-stage glass blur specular reflection animations on iOS
reduction_audit.rationale: Decorative eye-candy that drains battery and harms outdoor sunlight contrast. Replaced with clean Apple system materials.

reduction_audit.element: Continuous vehicle tracking polyline glow animation on transit routes
reduction_audit.rationale: Misleadingly implies real-time tracking when O-TRAVELZ transit data is static timetable schedules. Static crisp vector lines are truthful and performant.
Critical functional utility for on-the-ground pedestrian safety and first-mile decisions. Retained exactly as specified.

reduction_audit.element: Single-tap emergency essentials floating button in Active Trip
reduction_audit.rationale: High-priority traveler safety feature providing instant phone dialing to verified police and district hospitals.
Core to the Modern Odisha Cultural Atlas identity and local accessibility.

reduction_audit.element: Specific custom font asset bundling and licensing
reduction_audit.rationale: Belongs strictly in implementation waves M22 (Android) and M25 (iOS). Design phase uses system-native font cascades.

reduction_audit.element: Detailed Room / SwiftData indexing and schema migration rules
reduction_audit.rationale: Belongs in Wave M14 (Persistence). Conceptual schema is verified.

summary: Ponytail reduction successfully stripped out 4 unnecessary decorative elements, simplified 2 over-engineered interactions, preserved 3 critical truth/safety features, and deferred 2 implementation details. Net result: faster, leaner, and more truthful product systems.
